description.zh:
需要删除配置的加速域名，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，注意以下配置限制：

- 一次最多传20个域名。
- 域名个数乘以 FunctionNames个数，小于等于50。
description.en:
The accelerated domain names for which you want to delete configurations. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). Note the following limits:

- You can specify up to 20 domain names in a single request.

- The product of the number of domain names and the number of function names must be 50 or less.

description.zh: 需要删除的功能函数名称，多个用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次传入最多50个。更多功能名称，请参见[域名配置功能参数](~~410622~~)。
description.en: The names of the functions whose configurations you want to delete. Separate multiple function names with commas (,). You can specify up to 50 function names in a single request. For more function names, see [Domain configuration function parameters](~~410622~~).

descriptions.en: > - Request rate limit per user: 30 requests per second.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dcdn batch-delete-dcdn-domain-configs --domain-names example.com --function-names referer_white_list_set,https_force --region cn-hangzhou
